ayahOccurrences.text: لَمْ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: لَمْ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: فَكُّ is in the derivative form: فَكّ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ف/ك/ك f–k–k to dissemble, to dismantle, to separate, to free from bondage; to be weak; jaw.

Of this root, 2 forms occur 1 time each in the Qur’an:
فَكّ fakk and مُنْفَكّين munfakkın.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
فَكّ fakk [v. n.] freeing, setting free, untying *

(90:13) فَكُّ‏ ‏رَقَبَةٍ freeing of a slave‏ [lit. untying of a neck].

entries.label: مُنْفَكّ
entries.definitionHtml:
مُنْفَكّ munfakk [act./pass. part.] one who ceases an action, one who desists, one who leaves off, one who lets go of; something untied

(98:1)‏لَمْ يَكُنِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنْفَكِّينَ حَتَّى تَأْتِيَهُمُ الْبَيِّنَةُ those who denied [the truth] of the People of the Book and the idolaters would never desist till the Clear Sign came to them.
